body.message:
Thank you for your response.

I appreciate that you have followed up with the concerned team and I understand that there is an internal management approval process. However, the issue is that my checkout was completed on Monday last week, the property inspection has already been carried out, and the deductions have already been determined.

At this stage, I have been waiting for the refund for over a week, and I am still only being advised that I should wait for an internal approval. I don’t believe it is reasonable for the refund to remain open-ended when there is no outstanding action required from my side.

I therefore kindly request that this matter be escalated to the relevant management/finance decision-maker and that you provide me with a confirmed date by which the remaining security deposit will be refunded, rather than simply advising that you will update me when you receive further information.

Please also provide me with the final breakdown of the AED 3,000 security deposit, including the exact deductions and the net amount being refunded.

I would appreciate confirmation of the payment date by close of business tomorrow.

I have been patient and cooperative throughout this process, but I now need this matter resolved rather than receiving further general updates regarding the internal approval process.

Thank you, and I look forward to your prompt confirmation.
